acceptanceCriteria: A CLI fixture provides a scope deriver (or the equivalent seam) so `claim --next` runs NextClaimTicket end to end.
A CLI test asserts that `plan --pool` preview and `claim --next` select the same ticket with waiters present.
body: Gap from the PR #1087 review round (V1-0785, PSR-V0-132). internal/tasks/cli fixtures have no scope deriver, so the NextClaimTicket path that `claim --next` takes cannot be exercised through the public CLI; agreement with `plan --pool` holds only by construction (shared claimNextInput) and a transaction-level test. A divergence in CLI wiring (Now/Barrier inputs) would go undetected.
title: tests: CLI fixtures run without a scope deriver, so claim --next (NextClaimTicket) is unobservable end to end
